offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens, $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens, $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: Token-based pricing; search requests start from 10,000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens. Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five structured entries.
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；每次请求固定消耗 token，起始为10000；免费/付费密钥100 RPM，高级密钥1000 RPM。
